name: Rainforest Trust Protected or Conserved Area Creation Awards (under $250k)
summary: Grants to registered NGOs to create or expand protected or conserved areas on land or sea, through designation, land titling, purchase or OECMs, for requests under USD 250,000, reviewed on a rolling basis.

eligibility.rule: Protects globally key CR/EN populations, large tropical/subtropical high-integrity forests, or key climate habitat there
Project lead is a legally registered NGO authorized to work in the project country
Has government and Indigenous or community support, with relevant FPIC conducted or planned
Protection mechanism changes legal status and mitigates biodiversity and applicable carbon threats
Management plan and committee are or will be in place for sustained biodiversity conservation
Sets or will set limits on resource extraction to prevent unsustainable use
If land tenure is the main strategy, Indigenous Peoples or local communities lead substantial management

status.quote: Concept notes are accepted anytime, and reviewed within 1-2 months.

applicant_types.quote: All applicants must be legally registered, non-government organizations that are authorized to conduct work in the country of the proposed project.

geography.quote: Our primary focus is the tropics and subtropics but strong proposals from outside these areas that meet all other criteria will be considered.

access.quote: We only review applications submitted directly by eligible organizations, and we will work with you to refine your proposal if it aligns with our mission and priorities.

window.quote: Protected or Conserved Area Creation Feasibility Awards; Protected or Conserved Area Creation Awards of less than $250,000: These are accepted on a rolling basis and may be funded anytime throughout the year.

amount.quote: Protected or Conserved Area Creation Feasibility Awards; Protected or Conserved Area Creation Awards of less than $250,000: These are accepted on a rolling basis and may be funded anytime throughout the year.

effort.quote: Submit a Concept Note through our online form.
If your concept note is successful, you will be contacted by a Rainforest Trust staff member and invited to submit a detailed application via our online portal system.

eligibility.quote: The proposed area(s) must be currently unprotected.

2.1 Protect globally significant populations of Critically Endangered and Endangered species (e.g. Key Biodiversity Area (KBA) and Alliance for Zero Extinction (AZE) sites); AND/OR iii, iv 2.2 Protect large areas of Tropical and Sub-tropical High Integrity Forests; AND/OR 2.3 Protect Tropical and Sub-tropical habitat critical for mitigating global climate change
The Project Implementer must be a legally registered non-government organization and authorized to conduct work in the country of the project.

The project demonstrates support from relevant governments (including Indigenous governments) and Indigenous Peoples and/or Local Communities, and that relevant Free Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) has been or will be properly conducted.
The protection mechanism, resulting in a change in legal status of the area during the course of the project, will mitigate critical threats to biodiversity and, where applicable, to carbon storage.
A management system (management plan and committee) is, or will be, in place that ensures positive and sustained outcomes for the in situ conservation of biodiversity.
Resource extraction limits are, or will be, established to prevent unsustainable use.

8. Projects where Indigenous Peoples' and/or Local Communities' Land Tenure is the Primary Conservation Strategy 8.1 Substantial management authority of the area will be led by the Indigenous Peoples or Local Communities.
